scope: Incremental flow and state consistency repairs, not full-page or whole-app acceptance
authorization: User selected flow/state fixes only. Do not revise either conventions document or introduce the proposed press effects, motion variants, nine-step progress, carousel pauses or haptics.
approved_deltas: Auto Match options reuse the source no-result layout, but the Store derives truthful searching/paused/no-result text and return labels from the same match_id. Returning to an active search performs no business write; a true no-result retry retains its existing admission and charging policy.

Private and event conversations share a transient near-bottom reading policy. Initial entry follows the conversation tail; incoming messages, keyboard viewport changes, image readiness and warm returns follow only while the reader is near the bottom. A successful own send explicitly reveals the actual tail, including a long last message. No message or reading offset is duplicated in business storage.
All activity-card participant rows open the participants of their own event_id and stop parent-card navigation. Existing interaction ID and destination validation are reused.

The Store derives ended/full join labels and disabled states for both event cards and details. Disabled entry does not open confirmation or write; action-level eligibility and capacity revalidation remain. Joined event chat and management entries remain accessible.

Onboarding Continue remains reachable above the keyboard through the existing visual-viewport and single safe-area owners; keyboard closing restores normal spacing. No progress counts or step order are changed.

Main Tabs suppress content and route to the existing authentication/setup destination when authentication expires, including while the page remains visible. The redirect is guarded against duplicate navigation and preserves a retry on navigation failure.
